derivation.pi_rule: share of stock-days with RV21 >= own median x (1 + m_panic)/2
derivation.sbar_scale: 1/sqrt(kappa): C's calm-regime level scaled so the unconditional innovation variance over the regime mix stays sbar^2 (identity, PREREG 3.4)
derivation.p_entry: p_exit s/(1-s), s = (m_x(phase)-1)/(v_ratio-1), capped at 1 (panic hits the cap by construction); calm/other = p_entry_base from pi
